command:
set -e
TZ=America/New_York date '+%Y-%m-%d %I:%M:%S %p %Z'
docker stop --timeout 120 minecraft
docker inspect minecraft --format 'running={{.State.Running}} exit={{.State.ExitCode}}'
python3 - <<'PY'
import subprocess,json
s=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['docker','inspect','minecraft']))[0]['State']
assert not s['Running'] and s['ExitCode']==0
print('Minecraft clean shutdown verified')
PY
